context_and_flow.screen_type: Mobile app UI, Password Reset Confirmation Screen
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Confirm to the user that a password reset request has been processed and guide them on next steps.
ux_patterns: The checkmark icon is inside a circular container in a deep teal color, signifying completion or success.
The UI uses high-contrast typography for readability.
The back arrow at the top left provides navigation to return to the previous screen.
Accessibility: The teal text for 'Resend Link' provides a clear call to action.
